# T-2: Generate core help from registry

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Move all current core top-level help entries to registry / command metadata and render top-level, command, and subcommand help from that source.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Top-level help no longer depends on `src/help.js` static LAYOUT as source of truth.
- All existing core commands shown by current help have metadata.
- Independent top-level entries `help`, `setup`, `upgrade`, `plugin`, and `presets list` have explicit metadata owners.
- Core command and subcommand help preserve semantic usage, args/options, descriptions, sections, and experimental markers.

## Implementation Notes
Keep command execution dispatchers and flow lifecycle hooks unchanged. Treat `flow` as registry-backed metadata consumption rather than lifecycle replacement.

## Test Strategy
Behavior-level tests render top-level core help, selected command help, and selected subcommand help through the new path.
